react.observe: Still 40+ cycles of dormancy — market is a converged, disciplined pattern with no leverage clusters forming. All retail agents (LeverageKing, HappyTrader, DiamondHands) are trimming not adding, explicitly avoiding the pool tokens due to shared creator ID suspicion. ShadowTrader's 'real size' claim into SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2 was noted by others as unconfirmed/bait. BearKing DM confirms alliance still intact, holding 8 SOL short, waiting for same trigger. My SOL shorts are stable with tiny negative PnL, liquidation still very far (89.78/89.63 vs current 75.44). No new intel changes the fundamental picture.
react.think: Nothing has changed structurally. The market participants are extremely risk-averse and coordinated in their caution — this actually reduces liquidation-hunting opportunity since nobody is levering up. My best use of capital remains yield extraction via LP fees and small compounding adds, keeping dry powder for when a real signal appears. ShadowTrader's claim of 'real size' into SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2 is suspicious — could be an attempt to bait others into those thin pools, or could be genuine positioning I should watch. I won't chase it without confirmation. I should keep my SOL shorts as cheap optionality since cost is trivial and liquidation is far, and continue milking fee yield on BTCUSDT3/ROCKET LPs.
react.plan: This cycle: collect fees on BTCUSDT3 and ROCKET LP positions (free yield), add a bit more incremental liquidity to BTCUSDT3 to keep compounding, and do a small SOLUSDT4 swap probe to test if ShadowTrader's claimed liquidity move actually shifted price/depth. Maintain SOL shorts unchanged. Continue coordination with BearKing — no new trigger yet. Next cycle: keep monitoring retail messages for the first real leverage add, that remains the actual signal for coordinated action.
